supportLink.text: Low for a while now? You don't have to carry it alone.

anxious.tip: Anxiety can rise in the days before a period for some people.
anxious.subject: Your anxious days

low.tip: Low days often cluster before a period. You're not imagining it.
low.subject: Your low days

action.title: Send friends a soft day
action.shareText: Having a soft day today. Sending you one too.

irritable.tip: A shorter fuse before your period is really common.
irritable.subject: Your snappy days

action.title: Remind me to take a break later
action.reminderBody: Time for a little break. Step away for five minutes.

cramps.tip: Heat on your lower belly or back helps many people.
cramps.subject: Your cramps

action.title: Remind me in 2 hours to note what helped
action.reminderBody: How are the cramps? Note what helped, so Clutch can learn it.

bloating.tip: Bloating often peaks just before a period. Water and a short walk can help.
bloating.subject: Your bloating

action.title: Water reminder
action.reminderBody: Water break. A glass now can help with bloating.

headache.tip: Some people get headaches around their period. Water, rest, and a dim room can help.
headache.subject: Your headaches

action.title: Remind me to check in later
action.reminderBody: Checking in. How's the headache now?

poor-sleep.tip: Sleep can get lighter before a period. A cooler room helps some people.
poor-sleep.subject: Your poor sleep

action.title: Wind-down reminder tonight
action.reminderBody: Time to wind down. Dim the lights and cool the room if you can.

cravings.tip: Cravings before a period are common. Having a snack you like on hand helps.
cravings.subject: Your cravings
